question: How formidable is this seed in relation to time and all beings?
premises: The seed is itself equal to the fire of time.
It is terrifying to all beings.
Its power is inherently destructive and fearsome.
inference: The Parāprāsāda seed is as fearsome as the fire of time to all beings.
plain_english: It is itself equal to the fire of time and terrifying to all beings.
